description: This Java source file defines the LoyaltyCardReader class which implements NFC card reading functionality specific to loyalty cards. It manages NFC tag discovery, communicates with NFC tags via ISO-DEP protocol, and processes responses including extracting account details from the NFC tag.

classes.name: LoyaltyCardReader
classes.description: Implements NFC reading for loyalty cards, handling NFC tag discovery and communication, and invokes a callback with the account info extracted from the NFC tag.

classes.name: LoyaltyCardReader.AccountCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback to deliver the account number received from NFC card.

methods.name: LoyaltyCardReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NFC reader with a callback.

methods.name: onTagDiscovered
methods.description: Handles NFC tag discovered event, communicates with the tag, and retrieves account data if present.

methods.name: BuildSelectApdu
methods.description: Constructs an APDU command to select a specific AID on the NFC card.

methods.name: ByteArrayToHexString
methods.description: Converts byte array to hex string for logging or processing.

methods.name: HexStringToByteArray
methods.description: Converts hex string to byte array for constructing APDU commands.
